zoneNotes: Chapter 01 Landmarks: the groups the person picked on 2026-11-23 (candidate map), by OSM building name from the Overpass pull of 2026-11-23. (1) Terminal 1 main building (relation/6848621). (2) The Satellite Building (relation/4504617), linked to Terminal 1 by the Aerotrain. (3) klia2: the terminal (relation/13829161), its main and satellite buildings, the four piers and the skybridge. (4) gateway@klia2 with the transport hub roof and the Medan Kereta car park. (5) AirAsia: RedQ headquarters and the Tune hotel at klia2. (6) The control towers: KUL ATC Tower East (119 m in OSM), ATC Tower West and the apron tower. (7) Sama-Sama Hotel by Terminal 1. (8) The cargo area (OSM names, incl. 'Malaysia Airports Centralised Automated Warehouse'). (9) Mitsui Outlet Park KLIA Sepang. (10) The Sepang International Circuit grandstands and pit building ('South Padock' is the OSM spelling). The former LCCT and the airport mosque are not picked; the runways and the race track are not in the pull (the shared Overpass query has no aeroway=runway or highway=raceway).
landmarkNotes: Selected by OSM name (Overpass, 2026-11-23): the two terminals and the Satellite Building, the tallest control tower, the two malls and the circuit's pit building.
anchorNotes: Walk ends at the centre of each OSM building outline (Overpass, 2026-11-23). Routes snap to the nearest mapped pedestrian node. The ERL stations (KLIA T1 node/6763983630, KLIA T2 way/1033454811) carry no ref tag in OSM, so they are not used as station anchors.
walkNotes: Three walks: Terminal 1 to the Sama-Sama hotel along the covered link, klia2 to gateway@klia2, and gateway@klia2 to AirAsia RedQ. The terminals are 2 km apart and linked by the KLIA Ekspres / Transit, not on foot.
modelNotes: The ERL (KLIA Ekspres and KLIA Transit, OSM name 'ERL') is matched by the shared rail list as 'erl'. The Aerotrain between Terminal 1 and the Satellite Building (OSM railway=monorail 'APM', partly in tunnel) has no line id of its own and is kept as 'other'.
